steps.title: The Drawdown Protocol
steps.text: 2030. You lead a small coalition with one promise: a carbon-neutral world by 2100. You get one move per year - 71 in total. Let's learn the table in one minute.

steps.title: The three pillars
steps.text: Money funds every policy. The carbon ledger compares emissions E against absorption A - their balance drives everything. Happiness keeps society on board. Hover any number for details.

steps.title: The thermometer
steps.text: Net-positive carbon pushes warming up. Past +1.5 C the world enters Overshoot: harsher events, straining sinks. At +2.0 C the run is lost - the one hard defeat.

steps.title: The world
steps.text: Twelve regions render the global simulation: rust bar for emissions, green for absorption. Coastal, arid and forested regions attract different disasters. Gold rings mark allies.

steps.title: Inspect a region
steps.text: Click any region now. Its shares, vulnerabilities, scars and alliance status appear in the inspector on the right.

steps.title: The Policy Board
steps.text: All 15 policies, always visible - dimmed cards state their reason. Note the sufficiency cards: technology alone stalls every sector at 70%; sufficiency lifts the ceiling to 100%.

steps.title: Enact one policy
steps.text: Play one card now - one per year, so the whole game is choosing what moves the needle most. The Independent Media Fund is a fine opening.

steps.title: Resolve the year
steps.text: Press Space: income, ledger, warming, happiness - and perhaps an event. Passing is legal too: Space twice banks the money for later.

steps.title: Events and resilience
steps.text: The log explains every number. Heat waves, fires, floods and social crises hit harder as warming rises - resilience (happiness + adaptation) softens them. Every crisis opens a door: watch for the green beat.

steps.title: Diplomacy is scale
steps.text: Each ally pays +20 money and +1 influence yearly, and joint projects push all three sectors at once. Being allied always beats being alone.

steps.title: Knowledge persists
steps.text: Press H to open the Knowledge tree. Every run - won or lost - earns Knowledge Points to unlock permanent insights. Defeat is never a reset.

steps.title: How it ends
steps.text: Win: reach 2100 with emissions at or below absorption. Lose: touch +2.0 C, any year. Reaching 2100 without neutrality is a soft loss - but the Knowledge stays. Good luck, Signatory.
